senses.en: to no longer have something because it is taken away, destroyed, or no longer available

example.en: She lost her job last year.

senses.en: to be defeated in a game, competition, or argument

example.en: Our team lost the final by two points.
example.zh: 我们队以两分之差输掉了决赛。

senses.en: to be unable to find someone or something

example.en: I lost my keys on the bus.
example.zh: 我把钥匙丢在公交车上了。

senses.en: to fail to use an opportunity or time well

example.en: Don't lose this chance to learn.
example.zh: 不要错过这个学习的机会。

senses.en: used to refer to a person or thing of a particular kind

example.en: I don't usually read such books.

senses.en: used to emphasize how great or extreme something is

example.en: She had such a lovely voice that everyone stopped to listen.
example.zh: 她的嗓音如此动听，大家都停下来听。

senses.en: used to refer back to a kind or degree already mentioned or shown
senses.zh: 这样的人或事物；如此的程度或情形

example.en: Such was the storm that all flights were cancelled.
example.zh: 暴风雨如此猛烈，所有航班都被取消了。

senses.en: a person who is in charge of workers or an organization

example.en: My boss asked me to finish the report by Friday.
example.zh: 我的老板让我在周五前完成报告。

senses.en: to tell someone what to do in a controlling way

example.en: She is always bossing the younger kids around.
example.zh: 她总是对较小的孩子发号施令。

example.en: That new song is really boss.
She stayed home because she was tired.
example.zh: 她因为累了而待在家里。

senses.en: used in 'because of' before a noun or noun phrase to give a reason
senses.zh: 用于 because of，后接名词或名词短语，表示原因

example.en: The flight was delayed because of fog.
